timingGuidance: 6-8s workflow scene; reveal nodes left-to-right, draw connectors, then lock final action node with tl.set.
usageRules: Use instead of generic flowchart for source theses that convert raw knowledge into context, format, and action.
Keep connectors deterministic and avoid async or random layout.
Use as an open canvas or full-scene frame when the pipeline has more than four nodes.
